paper.title_en: Full-Stokes response to a stochastic gravitational-wave background in pulsar timing arrays: Fully analytic overlap reduction functions at finite distance and coherence of close pulsar pairs
paper.abstract_en: We derive fully analytic overlap reduction functions for the full-Stokes response of a pulsar timing array to an anisotropic tensor gravitational-wave background in general relativity. The response retains both pulsar distances and their complete propagation phases. At each fixed finite sky multipole, the intensity and circular polarization responses reduce to finite combinations involving exponential integrals and logarithms, while the electric and magnetic linear polarization responses require only elementary functions. We evaluate all components through $\ell=8$. Symmetry separates exact nulls from additional Earth-term nulls that propagation can lift. Even an unpolarized background can produce an imaginary cross-spectrum. For a pair with three-dimensional separation $d$, the pulsar terms can remain coherent when $2πfd/c\lesssim1$, even if both pulsars are many wavelengths from Earth. A uniform approximation retaining all four Earth and pulsar terms connects this regime to the short-wavelength limit, and a rotationally invariant relation fixes the leading transverse magnetic response. Common-distance errors cancel from the aligned pair phase, while relative-depth errors directly affect coherence. Under Gaussian differential averaging, fixed low-multipole norms and the squared norm summed over all multipoles decay at different rates as the response shifts to higher multipoles. Published pulsar configurations illustrate the roles of distance accuracy, bandwidth, and timing fits. At fixed pointwise intensity, a polarization covariance bound and a relative-depth noise budget quantify when differencing suppresses the background. Independent sky integration and matched-accuracy benchmarks test the analytic expressions over the parameter ranges studied.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文针对脉冲星计时阵列中随机引力波背景的全斯托克斯响应，给出包含脉冲星距离与传播相位的完全解析重叠约化函数，并讨论近距离脉冲星对的相干性、距离误差与带宽影响，与PTA主题高度相关且理论深度与新颖性信号较强，值得进一步阅读。
decision.title_zh: 脉冲星计时阵列中随机引力波背景的全斯托克斯响应：有限距离下的完全解析重叠约化函数与近距离脉冲星对的相干性
decision.abstract_zh: 我们在广义相对论框架下，推导了脉冲星计时阵列对各向异性张量引力波背景作出响应的全斯托克斯完全解析重叠约化函数。该响应保留了脉冲星距离及其完整的传播相位。在每一个固定的有限天空多极矩下，强度与圆偏振响应化为涉及指数积分与对数的有限组合，而电场与磁场线偏振响应仅需初等函数。我们计算了直至 $\ell=8$ 的所有分量。对称性将精确零点与传播可能消除的额外地球项零点区分开来。即使是无偏振背景也能产生虚部交叉谱。对于三维间距为 $d$ 的脉冲星对，当 $2\pi f d/c\lesssim1$ 时，脉冲星项仍可保持相干，即使两颗脉冲星距地球均为许多波长。保留全部四个地球项与脉冲星项的均匀近似将该区域与短波极限联系起来，且一个旋转不变关系确定了领先的横向磁场响应。共同距离误差在对齐脉冲星对相位中相消，而相对深度误差直接影响相干性。在高斯差分平均下，固定低多极矩范数与对所有多极矩求和的范数平方在响应移向更高多极矩时以不同速率衰减。已发表的脉冲星构型说明了距离精度、带宽与计时拟合所起的作用。在固定逐点强度下，偏振协方差界与相对深度噪声预算量化了差分在何时抑制背景。独立天空积分与匹配精度基准在研究所覆盖的参数范围内检验了这些解析表达式。
